value.value: MUA 3/5 nm produces dose-dependent ATP decreases while 10 nm is largely unaffected in prose; AUT reduces ATP at all tested sizes and concentrations. Concurrent NAC does not restore ATP or observed viability. No numeric curve values digitized.

conflicts: Negative MUA/MPA: 20, 80, 160 µg/mL. Positive dose labels differ by assay/panel: general methods 0.5, 5, 20 µg/mL; Figures 2B, 3D, 4B, 5B use 0.5, 3.5, 20; Figure 3B images and Figures 5D/6 use their explicit labels. Never merge 3.5 and 5.
